Designation: - Trade Operations Analyst-II 
Process: - Trade Settlement 
 
Roles and Responsibilities: - 
➢ Monitored real time trade flow in system, ensuring trades are accurately captured, validated, and 
ready for clearing settlement 
➢ Identify, investigate, and resolve trade breaks and exceptions in real time by directly liaising with 
traders, clearing members, and settlement desks. 
➢  Drive trade settlement coordination, ensuring smooth handover between front and back office while 
meeting tight market deadlines. 
➢  I resolve trade breaks in system and exception to meet T+1 settlement deadlines while minimizing 
regulatory risk and Buy-in 
➢ Managed client escalation on trade status and settlement ensuring SLA adherence. 
➢ Performing root cause analysis on trade mismatched to reduce fails and improve settlement. 
➢  Need to regular communicate with brokers and counterparties on settlement status and fails 
resolution. 
➢ I coordinate with risk, legal and compliance to close fails with in T+3 and regulatory timelines. 
➢  Produce and present regulatory and market activity reports (monthly, quarterly, annual) to senior 
management, ensuring compliance with exchange rules. 
Liaise with clients, traders, senior leaders, and support staff to facilitate trade confirmations and 
problem resolution.
